known_limitations: No acquired and validated real image with cached TrueCrypt passphrases. Win7/Win10 test captures have no matching truecrypt.sys module; all four agreements are empty and are not positive evidence.

Synthetic vectors cover PE32/PE32+, signed length selection, min-length 0/4/5/65/-1, ASCII limits, padding, skipped NUL, section-relative alignment, section name case and candidates extending beyond the section. These do not substitute for real positive images.
Native min-length is a signed 64-bit integer. Python reference accepts arbitrary-precision integers; values outside i64 are not accepted by CLI/MCP.
Native section header count is bounded to 96, scanning to 64 MiB, and output to 100000 rows. Truncation emits partial diagnostics; these budgets differ from the unbounded reference loops.

Uncaptured valid/transition reads retain partial results and coverage counts rather than filling bytes; the pinned reference may abort on the first missing field. Prototype/pagefile recovery and other memory formats are not verified for this plugin.
Missing or non-DWORD-aligned .data sections and selected negative-length records fail. Full failure-class/message parity and all real architectures/builds remain unverified.
Preserves the fixed reference behavior that skips the would-be NUL byte while checking three following zero bytes. Outputs are candidates, not independently verified mounted-volume passwords.
